description: Aglomerācijas (komunālie notekūdeņi) is a dataset listed in Latvian Geospatial Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo-dpps.viss.gov.lv. Active agglomerations in Latvia included in the Article 15 report of Directive 91/271/EEC concerning urban waste water treatment on the implementation of the Directive (a zone where the population and/or economic activities are sufficiently concentrated to cause a pollution load of not less than 2 000 population equivalents). Coverage: LV. The portal shows the English title as "Agglomerations (Urban waste water)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2019-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geolatvija.
